description: This file defines a theme configuration for terminal output styling using the 'chalk' library. It sets up color styles based on a palette and environment variables, providing functions to determine terminal richness and to apply colorization.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the terminal output supports rich colors based on the 'chalk' level.

methods.name: colorize
methods.description: Applies the specified color function to the string if terminal supports rich colors; otherwise, returns the original string.

ctags.name: baseChalk
ctags.pattern: /^const baseChalk = process.env.NO_COLOR && !hasForceColor ? new Chalk({ level: 0 }) : chalk;$/

ctags.name: colorize
ctags.pattern: /^export const colorize = (rich: boolean, color: (value: string) => string, value: string) =>$/
